root_cause.text: The `skbuff_fclone_cache` slab cache was initialized without defining a usercopy whitelist for the `sk_buff.cb` field, so when `sock_recv_errqueue()` attempts to copy `skb->cb` data (specifically the `sock_exterr_skb` structure) to userspace via `put_cmsg()`, the hardened usercopy check aborts because the underlying SLUB object has no allowed region for copying to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "skbuff_fclone_cache was created without defining a usercopy region, unlike skbuff_head_cache which properly whitelists the cb[] field." The crash backtrace shows a BUG at `mm/usercopy.c:102` from `__check_heap_object` failing on an `skbuff_fclone_cache` object. The patch introduces a local stack buffer (`ee`) as a bounce copy to avoid the direct usercopy check.
